events.verdict: Pippen Jr. (MEM) briefly has a hand placed towards Alvarado's (NOP) front, but the contact does not affect his SQBR.
Morant (MEM) cleanly steals the incoming pass away from Missi (NOP).

Murphy III (NOP) makes clean contact with the ball to dislodge it away from Pippen Jr. (MEM) during the play at the basket. Additionally, he is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Olynyk (NOP) reaches in and brushes Bane's (MEM) arm and the contract does not affect his SQBR.

Bane (MEM) slightly extends his left arm to release from Olynyk (NOP), who is retreating backwards in Bane's path. The contact is marginal and Olynyk's momentum continues to carry him backward.

Bane (MEM) has his off-arm extended when he places it against Olynyk (NOP), whose momentum carries him backwards as Bane releases.

Replay review of the goaltend called on Missi (NOP) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Missi blocks the shot attempt by Bane (MEM) before the ball reaches its apex. Memphis is given possession of the ball when play resumes because Clarke (MEM) had imminent possession of the loose ball.
Clarke's (MEM) shot attempt fails to make contact with the rim and the shot clock expires.
Olynyk (NOP) avoids making any contact with Clarke (MEM) as he reaches in.
Wells (MEM) moves forwards into Murphy III's (NOP) lower body, initiating illegal contact that affects his shot attempt near the rim.
Alvarado (NOP) immediately slides his hand off of Morant's (MEM) side during the throw-in.
Hawkins (NOP) moves alongside Morant's (MEM) path and maintains a legal guarding position during the driving shot attempt.
Olynyk (NOP) makes clean contact with the loose ball to deflect the rebound away from Clarke (MEM).
Murphy III (NOP) legally contests Bane's (MEM) jump shot attempt.
Morant (MEM) initiates illegal contact with Olynyk's (NOP) shoulder and body on his way to the ball during the rebound.
Edey (MEM) and Missi (NOP) each engage with one another during the rebound.
Brown (NOP) commits a take foul on Morant (MEM).
Bane (MEM) legally contests Alvarado's (NOP) jump shot attempt.
Hawkins (NOP) keeps the ball in play and does not step out of bounds.
Olynyk (NOP) fumbles the pass before legally taking two steps into his shooting motion.
Clarke (MEM) legally contests Olynyk's (NOP) jump shot attempt.
